mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_space_permission_table (space_id, user_id, target_node_id, can_read, can_write, can_delete, can_share, can_invite, can_manage, can_view, can_download, can_upload, can_edit, can_manage_members, can_manage_plugins, can_manage_settings, granted_by) VALUES (#{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{targetNodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{canRead}, #{canWrite}, #{canDelete}, #{canShare}, #{canInvite}, #{canManage}, COALESCE(#{canView}, #{canRead}), COALESCE(#{canDownload}, #{canRead}), COALESCE(#{canUpload}, #{canWrite}), COALESCE(#{canEdit}, #{canWrite}), COALESCE(#{canManageMembers}, #{canInvite}), COALESCE(#{canManagePlugins}, #{canManage}), COALESCE(#{canManageSettings}, #{canManage}), #{grantedBy,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE can_read = VALUES(can_read), can_write = VALUES(can_write), can_delete = VALUES(can_delete), can_share = VALUES(can_share), can_invite = VALUES(can_invite), can_manage = VALUES(can_manage), can_view = VALUES(can_view), can_download = VALUES(can_download), can_upload = VALUES(can_upload), can_edit = VALUES(can_edit), can_manage_members = VALUES(can_manage_members), can_manage_plugins = VALUES(can_manage_plugins), can_manage_settings = VALUES(can_manage_settings), granted_by = VALUES(granted_by), granted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
